plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: A deciduous ornamental tree that produces masses of delicate, fragrant flowers on bare branches before the leaves emerge. Widely planted in parks and along streets, it is the centerpiece of spring flower-viewing celebrations.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to mid-April in temperate Northern Hemisphere (peak bloom in Washington D.C. and Japan around late March to early April)
plants.location: Japan, Washington D.C. (USA), South Korea, and temperate regions across Europe and North America
plants.funFact: The 3,000 cherry trees given by Tokyo to Washington D.C. in 1912 are the origin of the National Cherry Blossom Festival, and nearly all Yoshino cherries are clones propagated by grafting from a single original tree.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: A bulbous perennial with trumpet-shaped yellow flowers and blue-green strap-like leaves. It naturalizes in meadows and woodlands, and countless cultivars are grown in gardens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late February to April in the Northern Hemisphere
plants.location: Western Europe, including the UK, France, and Spain; widely naturalized in North America
plants.funFact: All parts of the daffodil contain toxic alkaloids such as lycorine, but galantamine, a compound derived from related Narcissus species, is used to treat symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Magnolia × soulangeana
plants.description: A small deciduous tree or large shrub bearing large, goblet-shaped flowers in spring before its leaves unfurl. It is a hybrid of Magnolia denudata and Magnolia liliiflora and is a favorite in temperate gardens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to April in temperate Northern Hemisphere
plants.location: Cultivated across the eastern United States, the UK, Europe, and East Asia; parent species native to China
plants.funFact: Magnolias are among the most ancient flowering plants and evolved before bees existed, so their tough flowers are adapted to be pollinated by beetles.

plants.name: Colchicum autumnale
plants.description: Although not in bloom in the north, related Southern Hemisphere autumn bloomers are active now. Here, the placeholder entry is replaced by the better-fit Amaryllis belladonna, a bulb that sends up leafless flower stalks topped by clusters of fragrant, trumpet-shaped blooms in the southern autumn.
plants.bloomingSeason: March to April in the Southern Hemisphere (late summer to autumn)
plants.location: Native to the Western Cape of South Africa; naturalized in Australia, New Zealand, and California
plants.funFact: Amaryllis belladonna is nicknamed the 'naked lady' because its flower stalks emerge without any leaves, which appear only later after the blooms fade.
